procedures.title: Refrigeration Incident Procedure (DEMO)
procedures.body: Escalate to the manager. Isolate potentially affected food and hold it until it has been assessed under the site's approved procedure. Call the refrigeration contractor. Record readings and every action. DEMO content, not food safety advice.

procedures.title: Refrigeration Incident Procedure (DEMO)

procedures.title: Unverified Allergen Information (DEMO)
procedures.body: If ingredient or allergen information is missing, do not assume the product is free of any allergen. Hold the product for allergen-sensitive guests until the supplier confirms in writing. DEMO content, not food safety advice.

procedures.title: Cooking Temperature Check (DEMO)
procedures.body: If a probe reading is below the site limit, keep cooking and measure again. Record the failed reading and the recheck as separate entries. DEMO content, not food safety advice.
